data.one_liner: Dart implementation of Quill Delta format for rich-text editing
data.what_it_does: Provides a Delta class to represent, compose, and transform rich-text changes in the Quill.js format. It can be used to build or integrate a rich-text editor in Dart applications.
use_when: You need to manipulate or serialize Quill Delta documents in a Dart/Flutter app
You are building a custom editor or syncing rich-text changes with a backend that uses Quill format
avoid_when: You are using a full-featured editor widget that already handles Delta internally
You only need simple text editing without Delta semantics
weaknesses: No built-in persistence or collaboration features
